name: golden-egal
//overrides: Security patches for transitive deps whose parents pin them to vulnerable versions. Next pins postcss 8.4.31 exactly and sharp ^0.34.5, so they can only be raised from here; each stays within the same major, so no API change. brace-expansion is scoped to typescript-estree on purpose - it is the only consumer on minimatch 10, which can take v5. A blanket override breaks ESLint, because minimatch 3 (eslint-plugin-import/react/jsx-a11y, @eslint/config-array) needs the v1 API and v1 has no patched release. Do NOT run `npm audit fix --force`: npm 'fixes' these by downgrading next to 9.3.3, which would destroy the app.
